anthropic.notes: POST /v1/messages with x-api-key and anthropic-version headers. On API version 2026-10-21 temperature/top_p/top_k are rejected, so the temperature mapping is shown to students but not sent. Thinking and effort are set per model in config/models.json (request_options); agent replies use structured outputs (output_config.format json_schema). max_tokens comes from limits.max_tokens (4000; thinking tokens would count toward it). timeout_seconds 90 overrides the shared 45 s limit for Claude. model_params can still add extra body fields per model.

huggingface.notes: OpenAI-compatible POST {base_url}/chat/completions with 'Authorization: Bearer <HF token>' (fine-grained token with 'Make calls to Inference Providers'). Shape taken from the Inference Providers docs; not tested live.

hkbu.notes: REST v1 gateway, OpenAI-compatible: POST {base_url}/chat/completions with 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Checked 2026-10-31 without a key: /api/v1/models and /api/v1/chat/completions answer 401 'Authorization must use Bearer authentication with a valid API key' (unknown routes answer 404). Model ids come from a third-party gateway README (github.com/AndyZHENG0715/HKBU-GenAI-Gateway), not official docs; set verified true after a live run. Temperature is not sent because some models on the gateway reject it. path_template may use {base_url}, {model} and {api_version}. request_style is 'openai_chat' (choices.0.message.content) or 'anthropic_messages' (content.0.text). supports_json_schema: set true only if the gateway accepts strict JSON Schema replies.

replay.notes: Serves prepared outputs; never uses the network or a key.
